summary: Iteration 3 tested staff/cashier roles, uploading photos and logos to object storage, the barcode scanner UI, WhatsApp sending, and regression of login, dashboard and POS. Backend: 21/21 pytest pass. Staff create returns 201, a duplicate email returns 409 (also for the owner email in a different case), and a cashier gets 403. GET /staff works. PATCH active=false makes both login and the existing token return 401. Cashier gets 403 on PUT /business, /backup and /backup/latest. In cashier sync push, finance and products are rejected and sales are applied. Cashier pull only returns the allowed entities. Upload of png works and the file downloads with ?token= or Bearer. With no token the download returns 401, a token from another business gets 404, and txt files and files over 5MB get 400. Cashier upload gets 403. Frontend (375x667) owner: the dashboard shows the logo and business name, and the Lainnya profile card shows the business name and the Pemilik badge. Pengaturan shows the logo PhotoPicker; uploading through the web file chooser worked. StaffSection creates a cashier and deactivates it, with a confirm dialog. On a fresh TEST account the saved logo appears in the dashboard header and the profile card. A product photo shows in the POS tile and the product list. POS search by barcode works. pos-scan-button opens the barcode-scanner modal with scanner-allow-camera, and scanner-close (44x44) closes it. The product form has product-photo and product-scan-barcode, and the scanner opens from it. The invoice WhatsApp send and reminder buttons and the customer reminder all open api.whatsapp.com/send with the phone number normalized to 62… and the right message text. Cashier: the dashboard shows the cashier view (cashier-sales-today, cashier-open-pos, cashier-recent-sales) with no owner KPIs. The Lainnya menu shows sales, customers, hpp, docs and settings. The products tab has no add button. /finance, /reports, /invoices, /purchases and /product-form all redirect to /pos. Settings hides the profile, backup, staff and demo sections. A cashier POS sale completed and synced to the server (verified via owner pull, cashier_name=Kasir Satu). One real bug: a cashier can create and edit Docs/SOP, but the server rejects the docs ops and the client drops rejected ops without telling anyone. The UI says 'Sinkronisasi berhasil, 0 perubahan menunggu' but the doc never reaches the server (verified). No deprecated Expo packages found (expo-camera and expo-image-picker are used, and there is no expo-av or expo-barcode-scanner).

minor.issue: Reads the whole body into memory before checking the 5MB limit. It also trusts the client's content_type without checking magic bytes (any bytes labelled image/png are accepted).
Errors from storage init, put or get (requests.HTTPError) are not caught and come back as a generic 500. Wrap them in HTTPException(502/503) with a friendly message.
The long-lived (multi-day) JWT is passed in the URL query, so it leaks into proxy/access logs and cached image URLs. Consider a short-lived signed file token.
There is no delete endpoint, so deactivated TEST staff stay in the list. Not a functional bug.

ui_bugs.issue: docs-add-button and the doc editor (save and delete) are available to the cashier. The server rejects 'docs' in CASHIER_PUSH, and sync.ts:66 treats rejected ops as done and removes them from the outbox. The cashier's doc stays on the device only, the UI reports a successful sync with 0 pending, and the owner never sees it (verified TEST_CashierDoc is not on the server). Either make docs read-only for the cashier (hide add/save/delete, or add 'doc' to OWNER_ROUTES), or allow docs in CASHIER_PUSH. Also show a toast or warning when ops are rejected instead of dropping them silently.

customers-add-button is shown to the cashier, but tapping it goes to /contact-form, which is in OWNER_ROUTES, so the cashier is bounced to /pos. This is confusing UX, and the server does allow cashier customer upserts. Either hide the button for cashiers or allow contact-form?entity=customers.

issues: The business name is cut off ('Toko Demo U…') because the sync pill takes the space. Allow 2 lines or shrink the pill.
The KPI label 'Penjualan saya hari ini' is cut off ('Penjualan saya h…').
The button label is cut off ('Kirim via Wha…') at 375 width. Use a shorter label like 'WhatsApp', or stack the two buttons.

action_items: HIGH: Fix the cashier Docs data loss. Either gate docs-add-button, doc-save-button and doc-delete-button behind isOwner (or add 'doc' to OWNER_ROUTES), or add 'docs' to CASHIER_PUSH in server.py.
In src/data/sync.ts, keep a visible record of rejected ops (toast or conflict-style list) instead of dropping them silently, and roll back the local change.
Hide customers-add-button for cashiers, or allow the cashier to reach contact-form for customers (the server already permits it).
Wrap object-storage errors in /upload and /files in HTTPException with a friendly message. Check the size before reading the whole body, or stream it.
Minor UI: text cut off in the dashboard business name, the cashier KPI label and the invoice WhatsApp button at 375px width.
Optional: when matching a scanned barcode, trim it and treat a 13-digit EAN with a leading 0 as equal to the 12-digit UPC-A (iOS reports UPC-A as EAN-13).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py sync_push: cashier-rejected ops come back in 'rejected', and the client (sync.ts:66) deletes them from the outbox with no feedback to the user, which causes silent data loss for any UI that lets a cashier edit entities outside CASHIER_PUSH.
_layout.tsx OWNER_ROUTES does not include 'doc'/'docs', yet the cashier cannot push docs. The client-side and server-side permission lists do not match.
media.tsx fileUrl embeds the JWT in the image URL. Re-logging in changes the URL, which also breaks the expo-image disk cache key.
No deprecated Expo packages found. The barcode scanner uses expo-camera CameraView, and camera and photo permissions are declared in app.json.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all requested flows work; cashier Docs sync data loss and cashier customer-add button misrouting found)

A demo-business owner POS sale was NOT completed (the payment amount was left at 0). kasir@usahora.id was never deactivated and is still active.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -n 0 (pytest.ini forces xdist -n 2). Use EXPO_BACKEND_URL=<EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env>; the frontend/.env key is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Login is rate limited (10/min per IP, 10 per 5 min per email). The web file chooser works for PhotoPicker via page.expect_file_chooser on the '<testID>-pick' button. Checkout needs checkout-quick-0 ('Uang pas') before checkout-confirm-button. WhatsApp opens a popup to api.whatsapp.com/send.
